newsitem.title: KUWAIT: U.S. troops deploy in Kuwait for joint exercise.
newsitem.headline: U.S. troops deploy in Kuwait for joint exercise.

text.p: U.S. ground forces have started a new deployment in Kuwait ahead of a joint exercise, the United States embassy said in statement on Tuesday.
"U.S. soldiers have begun to deploy from the United States to Kuwait," it said without disclosing the size of the force.
The troops, from First Cavalry Division in Fort Hood, Texas, will take part in "Intrinsic Action 97-1" exercise, the first of a series of wargames by U.S. ground troops planned for 1997.
Since the U.S.-led Gulf War liberated Kuwait in 1991 after a seven-month Iraqi occupation, Washington has been holding year-round Intrinsic Action exercises in Kuwait.
Arriving troops will draw on heavy armour, including main battle tanks, which Washington has pre-positioned at Kuwait's Camp Doha for immediate use in case of a new crisis.
In a fresh standoff with Baghdad, Washington in September ordered some 3,000 ground troops to Kuwait in addition to about 1,200 which were taking part in the Intrinsic Action exercise then.
The ground troops left in late 1996 but eight Stealth bombers which were sent to Kuwait at the time of the crisis are believed to be still deployed in the small Gulf Arab state.
